_note: VL53L0X time-of-flight laser ranging sensor module (STMicroelectronics). I2C interface, default address 0x29 (changeable via software after XSHUT sequence). 6-pin breakout: VCC, GND, SDA, SCL on bottom; XSHUT (active-low shutdown/reset, pull low to put in standby, release for multi-sensor address assignment), GPIO1 (interrupt output, active low, signals measurement ready) on top. Range 30-2000 mm, 940 nm VCSEL laser class 1. GY-VL53L0X module includes 2.8V regulator and level shifters.
